name.zh: 受 Montlivaltia 启发的有柄单体杯状珊瑚

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish wide flaring solitary cup rises from a narrow pedicel with closely spaced radial septa in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以宽外张单体杯自窄柄升起，杯内放射隔壁密排搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

sources.title: Scleractinia
sources.supports: Solitary cups and colonial scleractinian growth forms; does not verify all proposed genera.

reconstruction_notes.en: Nominal scale, palette, posture, simplified counts and fine relief are artistic. Original geometry only; no exact species/specimen, microscopic, locality, salinity or coexistence restoration. Cobbania mounts at the freshwater waterline with roots below it.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 名义尺度、配色、姿态、简化数量及细小起伏为美术选择。仅含原创几何；不主张精确物种标本、显微结构、地点、耐盐性或共存复原。Cobbania 以淡水水面挂点为原点，根部下垂。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
